name: mundoturisticomg
description: Mundo Turístico MG — Full-stack travel agency platform (personal & corporate trips)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @mtmg/api" "npm run dev -w @mtmg/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mtmg/shared && npm run build -w @mtmg/api && npm run build -w @mtmg/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @mtmg/api && npm run lint -w @mtmg/web
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run docker:up && sleep 3 && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
